lines.speaker: shubh
lines.text: Bhai, naya game aa gaya! Bas price check karta hoon...

lines.speaker: shubh
lines.text: Itna mehenga?! Price dekh ke toh mera PC bhi hang ho gaya!

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Arre Golu, full price kaun deta hai aajkal? Cheap PC Games pe dekh!

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Haan bhai! Yahan games shuru hi hote hain sirf ninety-nine rupaye se!

lines.speaker: shubh
lines.text: Game bhi khela, aur jeb bhi bachi!

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Games ninety-nine rupaye se shuru... saste mein kharido, apni jeb bachao!
